text:
adele: dropped a new compact "preview pulse" proposal for Alerting rows. idea is a one-line live preview that pulses open briefly with context instead of a full overlay. figma: https://redwood.design/s/preview-pulse.png

peter: neat idea. main issue I can see is keyboard discoverability and ensuring focus doesn't get lost when the pulse auto-closes. also potential layout shift on long channel lists.

leila: accessibility concerns: if it's not a true dialog we must still provide keyboard access and aria announcements. Recommend when pulse opens on user action we move focus to the preview header (tabindex=-1; focus()) and set aria-live="polite" text: "Preview opened for <channel>".

toni: copy note: the term "pulse" might confuse PMs. for user-facing copy we should keep "Preview" or "Notification preview". internal name fine as pulse. Also, unify "snooze" vs "mute" across the flow. my suggestion: "Snooze" = time-limited pause; "Mute channel" = silence channel until toggled. update help text accordingly.

sam: UX tradeoff: pulse (inline transient preview) reduces context switching but can be missed. overlay is more discoverable and easier to trap focus. Could we make pulse persistent when user expands, turning into a modal if they click a "More" control? That gives both compactness and accessibility.

peter: technical note: avoid animating height; use opacity + translateY for the pulse entrance to avoid relayout. sample CSS:
```
.pulse { transform: translateY(-6px); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; }
.pulse.open { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
```
This prevents the vertical jump.

leila: ensure the preview toggle has aria-expanded and the preview region has role="region" with aria-label like "Notification preview for <channel>". If we escalate to modal make it role="dialog" and aria-modal=true.

a11y-bot: automated scan: dark theme snooze pill contrast is 3.7:1; target >=4.5:1 for small UI text. Recommend darken bg token and bump font-weight. Also warn: do not rely on color alone for status chips.

toni: will adjust tokens. also propose microcopy for preview header: "How this alert notifies <channel>" — concise and actionable.

sam: telemetry: fire event on preview interaction: analytics.track('alert_preview.open', { ui: 'pulse'|'overlay', trigger: 'click'|'keyboard', channel_count: n }). helps decide which pattern users prefer.

peter: engineering follow-up: if we allow pulse -> expand to overlay, keep the DOM in place and only toggle classes to avoid reflow and keep screen reader context stable.

leila: keyboard flow: 1) user tabs to preview toggle; 2) activates preview; 3) focus moves to preview header; 4) tab cycles through chips (roving tabindex) and controls; 5) Esc closes and returns focus to toggle. Document this in the interaction spec.

a11y-bot: post-change checklist: axe run, NVDA and VoiceOver checks, keyboard-only smoke test, validate live region announcements are concise and not repeated.

adele: action items: 1) peter to implement CSS transform animation + keep DOM stable (ETA: today). 2) leila to write aria specs + prototype roving tabindex (ETA: tomorrow). 3) toni to update copy tokens and color tokens for snooze/mute (ETA: Fri). 4) sam to add telemetry for preview.open and pulse->overlay conversion (ETA: Thu). I'll update the figma frame with the "How this alert notifies <channel>" header and the persistent "More" affordance.

toni: minor: let's add quick snooze presets inline (15m, 1h, 8h) with accessible aria-labels like "Snooze for 15 minutes". Keep a small recent list too.

sam: final thought: A/B test pulse vs overlay via feature-flag and measure time-to-action and keyboard success rate. Add preview.variant to telemetry.

adele: thanks all 44d I'll post updated frames and the interaction spec when done.
